sampling: latest newly closed candle at each hourly collection; omitted candles are not backfilled
price_reference: last closed 5m price known at registration; differs from historical primary-close entry
first_outcome_candle: first complete 5m candle opening after recorded_at
rules: symmetric ATR target/stop first touch; both touched in same 5m bar neutral; gaps pending
multiple_comparisons: 15 prespecified combinations; no winner from raw maximum; temporal block uncertainty and multiple-testing correction required
limits: Historical selection is exploratory. These future observations are a separate research cohort, not mobile surveillance or a profitability simulation. Daily windows overlap and may remain statistically inconclusive after 180 days.
